name: vertical-thumbnail-slider
blurb: Vertical carousel with main slide and thumbnail column for navigation.
description: Vertical carousel with main slide display and vertical thumbnail navigation. Uses embla-carousel with axis='y' and right-to-left direction. Thumbnails are clickable to jump to slides.
use_when: Product or portfolio galleries displayed vertically with thumbnail navigation.
avoid_when: Small viewports—vertical layout with thumbnails needs significant height.
a11y: Thumbnail images are clickable. No keyboard navigation or ARIA labels. Carousel is read-only.
